title: YARF: Yet Another Random Forests Package
description: YARF is a customizable, asynchronous, and parallelized random forest implementation for R with user-defined JavaScript splitting and aggregation behavior, missingness incorporated in attributes, imputation, variable importance, interaction analysis, and tree inspection. Its forest engine is implemented in Java.

creators.name: Kapelner, Adam
